title: Resb
description:
## Resb:
What if you wanted data available, but you didn't have anything to put there yet. You couldn't just `db <datasize>`: That can't be changed, and just uses the size. Enter `resb`. You use the syntax `resb <amountofbytestoregister>`. Along with resb, there are of course 2 byte 4 byte and 8 byte versions of `resb`, `resw`, `resd` and `resq`, but it is simple. You just use `res<suffix> <count>`. Simple!
